description: arXiv:2611.13413v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: DeepSeek-V4.1's 203 GB of Engram n-gram tables sit in host DRAM today, taking 190 of the 223 GiB a 4-GPU serving process uses. Row indices depend only on input tokens, so reads can start with each step and overlap earlier layers. V4.1's two Engram layers have windows that differ by 30x (0.3 vs. 9.3 ms).
